items.title: Adobe Patches Magento Zero-Day Exploited to Deploy Rust Backdoor and PHP Web Shell
items.summary: Adobe on Monday released security patches to address a maximum-severity flaw impacting Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that has come under active exploitation in the wild. The vulnerability, now tracked as CVE-2026-75650 (CVSS score: 10.0), has been codenamed StyleSmuggler by Sansec, which discovered zero-day exploitation starting September 4, 2026. items.title: BengalSEO Poisons Bing Search Results to Deliver MayaBot and Tech Support Scams
items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a sprawling search engine optimization (SEO) poisoning campaign that paves the way for malware deployment and tech support scams. The campaign, discovered by the DFIR Report in March 2026, has been codenamed BengalSEO.
